brief:
Middle East Eye reviewed a documentary titled NAZA that features testimonies from Israeli military and intelligence whistleblowers addressing claims about the Gaza conflict. The film presents accounts challenging official narratives regarding the reasons behind operations in Gaza.

The documentary positions itself as countering what it characterizes as widespread myths about Israeli military actions, drawing on firsthand accounts from former officials within defense and intelligence sectors.

title: Documentary draws on whistleblowers to examine Israeli conduct in Gaza
